name: BCL6 corepressor like 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: BCORL1 encodes BCL-6 corepressor-like protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

function.text: BCORL1 encodes BCL-6 corepressor-like protein 1. It may specifically inhibit gene expression when recruited to promoter regions by sequence-specific DNA-binding proteins such as BCL6. This repression may be mediated at least in part by histone deacetylase activities which can associate with this corepressor.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BCORL1 have been reported in CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion, neuroblastoma, and high-Grade glioma, NOS.
